stage0033b_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$デキム$$
「To all of you watching this broadcast.」

stage0033b_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$デキム$$
「There are still fools who persist in
　futile resistance to the new order.」

stage0033b_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$デキム$$
「Just how much meaning is there
　in all the blood shed here...
　Think carefully on that!」

stage0033b_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「How is it, $$クィーン$$ $$リリーナ$$?
　Your rescuers' fate hangs by a thread.」

stage0033b_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「To everyone watching this broadcast!
　Peace is not something given to you
　by others. You must seize it yourself!」

stage0033b_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「You...!
　Doing as you please!」

stage0033b_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ナナリー$$
「I won't let you interfere with $$リリーナ$$!」

stage0033b_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「You brat!
　Think you can beat a man's strength?!」

stage0033b_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$デキム$$
「Former queen, your entrance is far too soon.」

stage0033b_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「Too bad, isn't it?
　Your desperate stand ended after
　sending out just a few words.」

stage0033b_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「That is enough.
　People are not as weak as you think.」

stage0033b_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$デキム$$
「You think mere words can move the masses?」

stage0033b_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「Leading the masses into battle?
　Doesn't that go against the total
　pacifism you once preached?」

stage0033b_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「I am not a Peacecraft.
　I am $$リリーナ・ドーリアン$$.」

stage0033b_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「And what we need now isn't ideology
　or argument, but a will for peace!」

stage0033b_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「And that, he will show to the world!」

stage0033b_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ドロシー#86$$
「How long do you intend to just sit there?」

stage0033b_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ドロシー#86$$
「$$マリーメイア$$ is the new master
　you've all been waiting for.
　Why not wag your tails and greet her?」

stage0033b_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ドロシー#86$$
「Oh my, I misspoke.
　Let me correct myself.」

stage0033b_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ドロシー#86$$
「You aren't the dogs wagging their tails
　for a master. You're the tails they wag.」

stage0033b_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
Citizen
「Keep talking...!
　I shot down five $$次元獣$$ in the
　$$再世戦争$$, believe it or not!」

stage0033b_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ドロシー#86$$
「And where is that man now?
　The warriors I know are all six feet
　under, or fighting in the sky above!」

stage0033b_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
Citizen
「Peace isn't given to you by someone else, huh...」

stage0033b_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
Citizen
「Even unarmed, there must be a fight we can wage...!」

stage0033b_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
Citizen
「Let's go, to the memorial hall!」

stage0033b_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
Citizen
「Yeah!
　There must be something we can do!」

stage0033b_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ドロシー#86$$
（Heh... such troublesome people...
　But this world hasn't rotted through completely...）

stage0033b_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ドロシー#86$$
（Lady $$リリーナ$$, $$ヒイロ・ユイ$$...
　The rest, I leave to you.）

stage0033b_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「Lord $$デキム$$!
　Citizens are gathering around the hall!」

stage0033b_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$デキム$$
「Leave them be!
　There's nothing they can do!」

stage0033b_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$デキム$$
「Even that lone Gundam left standing
　cannot break through this shelter!」

stage0033b_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$デキム$$
「If things turn against us, we simply
　take the ministers hostage and flee!」

stage0033b_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「$$マリーメイア$$...
　I returned from Peacecraft to Darlian
　not to avenge my father.」

stage0033b_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「Revenge creates nothing...
　Hatred only breeds more hatred.」

stage0033b_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「That's only because you lost your war!
　But I am different!
　I will become the victor!」

stage0033b_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ナナリー$$
「I'm all right, $$リリーナ$$.
　I'm prepared as well.」

stage0033b_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「There's nothing left for me to do.
　Let's leave the rest to $$ヒイロ$$.」

stage0033b_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$デキム$$
「W-we need to escape!
　They mean to really open fire!」

stage0033b_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$レディ$$
「$$デキム・バートン$$...!
　It's over for you!」

stage0033b_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$デキム$$
「$$レディ・アン$$...!
　When did you get into this shelter?!」

stage0033b_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「Are you speaking of my father?」

stage0033b_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$レディ$$
「Even if you are in the wrong,
　I cannot let Lord $$トレーズ$$'s daughter die.」

stage0033b_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$デキム$$
「Do you think you've won already, $$レディ・アン$$?!」

stage0033b_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$レディ$$
「There are no victors in this war.」

stage0033b_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$レディ$$
「Lord $$トレーズ$$ loved those who kept
　fighting on, even in defeat.」

stage0033b_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$レディ$$
「That spirit still lives on in people.
　That is why they embrace the Gundams
　that fight on. Victors don't move hearts.」

stage0033b_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$デキム$$
「Nonsense!
　We cannot lose!
　The Bartons are Earth Sphere's true rulers!」

stage0033b_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$デキム$$
「Lady $$マリーメイア$$!
　Stand at the very top of the Earth Sphere, now!」

stage0033b_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「I am... the victor...
　Father's will... I've inherited it...」

stage0033b_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「I'm sorry for hitting you.」

stage0033b_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「You have come to know fear.
　That is why you should now be able
　to admit your fault in starting this war.」

stage0033b_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「$$デキム・バートン$$!」

stage0033b_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$デキム$$
「I'd ask you not to fill my $$マリーメイア$$'s
　head with such nonsense!」

stage0033b_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「If you wish to shoot, go right ahead.
　I am prepared.」

stage0033b_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$デキム$$
「Then let me teach you truth before you die!
　The masses follow the victor!」

stage0033b_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「$$デキム$$!
　You mustn't shoot $$リリーナ$$!」

stage0033b_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$デキム$$
「Getting in my way, girl?!
　Then I'll shoot you along with her!」

stage0033b_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$デキム$$
「T-the bullet was deflected?!
　Who are you?!」

stage0033b_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「That's right, $$デキム・バートン$$.
　Naturally, I am here as well.」

stage0033b_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$デキム$$
「W-what are you here for, $$ゼロ$$?!」

stage0033b_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「If you're of the $$ＡＤＷ$$, you know the
　legend: where peace's foe appears, $$ゼロ$$ is there.」

stage0033b_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$デキム$$
「Y-you demon!
　Playing the judge now, are you?!」

stage0033b_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$デキム$$
「I know about your $$ギアス$$!
　Do you mean to kill my mind with it?!」

stage0033b_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「It is not I who will judge you.」

stage0033b_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「You should have known...
　only those ready to be shot may shoot!」

stage0033b_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「Th-the traitor has been executed!」

stage0033b_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「With this, I hope to atone for my
　betrayal of Lord $$トレーズ$$ and the world...」

stage0033b_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$レディ$$
「Thank you for your help, $$ゼロ$$, $$スザク$$.」

stage0033b_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$スザク$$
「No...
　We just lent a hand at the end」

stage0033b_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「The outcome was already decided
　by $c and $$ヒイロ$$」

stage0033b_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「A little later, and that man
　would've pulled the final trigger」

stage0033b_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Your brother $$ルルーシュ$$ is dead...
　I am $$ゼロ$$」

stage0033b_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ナナリー・ヴィ・ブリタニア$$...
　I hope we won't meet like this again...」

stage0033b_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$リリーナ$$
（They keep fighting for the world too...
　$c, my brother, $$ヒイロ$$...）

stage0033b_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$リリーナ$$
（Thank you, $$ヒイロ$$...
　I'll do all I can for this world too,
　so as not to shame you...）

stage0033b_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$五飛$$
「Then what is this world's distortion...!?
　Why won't the fighting end...!」

stage0033b_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$五飛$$... you're too pure for your own good」

stage0033b_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$五飛$$
「Did you come here to mock me?」

stage0033b_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「No, that's not it.
　But I can answer your question」

stage0033b_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$五飛$$... come with us.
　To find out where this world's distortion lies」

stage0033b_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$五飛$$
「Where do you intend to go?」

stage0033b_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$スウィート・ウォーター$$...」

stage0033b_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「He's utterly rattled, as you'd expect.
　He never imagined a declaration of war
　would come right before his eyes」

stage0033b_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$シャア$$
「But this war is strictly between
　Neo Zeon and the Earth Federation.
　No harm to the $$大統領$$ or his aides」

stage0033b_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$シャア$$
「I have business there besides.
　I'll see her home myself」

stage0033b_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「I don't like it.
　The supreme commander, so quick to move」

stage0033b_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$シャア$$
「I understand my role well enough.
　That's precisely why I use this name」

stage0033b_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「I can trust that, $$シャア$$?」

stage0033b_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$シャア$$
「Your wish, in yielding me the leader's seat...
　nor the Spacenoids' hopes, I won't betray」

stage0033b_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Then I'll restructure the whole chain
　of command, with $$マリーメイア$$'s remnants to absorb」

stage0033b_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「And you foresaw this outcome,
　and let $$デキム$$'s rashness slide, didn't you?」

stage0033b_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Those men would've outlived their use anyway.
　Using them to pin $c down on Earth
　was a fine result, if I say so myself」

stage0033b_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$シャア$$
「Impressive.
　You read my intent that far」

stage0033b_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「You've grown worldly enough to flatter.
　That's what a supreme commander should be」

stage0033b_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$シャア$$
「I'm counting on you, $$ハマーン$$」

stage0033b_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That may be the first time I've seen
　Her Excellency $$ハマーン$$ so candid」

stage0033b_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$シャア$$
「Part of what made her that way is on me」

stage0033b_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I hear that after the $$一年戦争$$,
　you spent your days with her on $$アクシズ$$」

stage0033b_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$シャア$$
「Not a time I remember fondly.
　I won't be discussing it」

stage0033b_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Does my presence displease you?」

stage0033b_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$シャア$$
「I understand the use of a body double,
　but facing my own face and voice still...」

stage0033b_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「A gift of surgery.
　The real me looked nothing like you, an ordinary man」

stage0033b_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「But once it became certain you'd been
　caught in the $$時空震動$$, someone like me
　became necessary」

stage0033b_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$シャア$$
「The legend of the Red Comet...」

stage0033b_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I'm only a body double after all.
　Now that the true Red Comet has returned,
　I'll fight as one soldier for the Spacenoids」

stage0033b_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$シャア$$
「Admirable resolve.
　But a body double's existence
　is always shadowed by tragedy...」

stage0033b_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「You mean the affair of $$プラント$$'s $$ラクス・クライン$$」

stage0033b_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「To play the supreme commander,
　I was made to study a fair amount」

stage0033b_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「And the difference between me and 《$$ミーア・キャンベル$$》
　is I still take pride in being a body double」

stage0033b_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$シャア$$
「...Had I never risen,
　you'd have gone on playing the Red Comet?」

stage0033b_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「If those around me wished it so」

stage0033b_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$シャア$$
「Then I've done you a disservice」

stage0033b_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Please don't concern yourself.
　Now that you've risen, I'll take the front lines」

stage0033b_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$ミネバ$$'s whereabouts concern me too,
　but there's also that other matter」

stage0033b_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「You don't seem very interested, do you」

stage0033b_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$シャア$$
「I've no wish to pry open Pandora's box」

stage0033b_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Understood.
　For now, I'll focus on the Earth Federation」

stage0033b_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「For now, I'll set Londo Bell as our target.
　...Now, if you'll excuse me」

stage0033b_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$シャア$$
（$$フル・フロンタル$$...
　Facing my own body double like this
　feels like being shown my own ugly side...）

stage0033b_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$シャア$$
（And this unease...
　Should I take it that his words hide a lie...）

stage0033b_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$シャア$$
（But I must admit his talent）

stage0033b_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$シャア$$
（Knowing $$マリーメイア$$ would one day be a liability,
　he's made her this useful all the same, by his skill）

stage0033b_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$シャア$$
（Though as a result, the people have come
　to reconsider what fighting means once more,
　perhaps because they don't know him... or $c...）

stage0033b_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$シャア$$
（But this means a direct strike on Earth
　now calls for caution...）

stage0033b_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$シャア$$
（$$アムロ$$... show me you can feel my will.
　Don't disappoint me...）

stage0033b_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Pleased to meet you, Master $$カトル$$.
　I'm delighted to make your acquaintance」

stage0033b_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$カトル$$
「You must be $$ＡＧ$$.
　I've heard about you from $$デュオ$$」

stage0033b_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Such polite speech, even for a slapdash
　robot like myself...
　As expected of you, Master $$カトル$$」

stage0033b_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$カトル$$
「Being addressed like that reminds me
　of everyone in the Maguanac Corps.
　I hope we can build a good relationship too」

stage0033b_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A kind man like you, Master $$カトル$$,
　that's how you talked that $$五飛$$ jerk around」

stage0033b_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Still, that thick-skulled oaf...
　ignoring even Master $$トロワ$$ and Miss $$カレン$$'s pleas,
　what an absolute nutcase」

stage0033b_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$カトル$$
「He's a dear friend of mine.
　Please don't speak of him that way」

stage0033b_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「M, my apologies!
　I... completely forgot that you, Master
　$$カトル$$, have a short fuse!」

stage0033b_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As an apology, I'll add the 200Z of
　Z-chips earned from your persuasion, Master
　$$カトル$$, to the squad's stock!」

stage0033b_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not that it's an afterthought, but to
　honor Miss $$ノイン$$ and Miss $$ヒルデ$$'s fine work
　this time, I've stocked up some mobile suits!」

stage0033b_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$カトル$$
「Thank you.
　Since you went to the trouble, I'll put them to good use」

stage0033b_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Ah, that was scary.
　Right alongside Miss $$スズネ$$, Master $$カトル$$ needs watching）

stage0033b_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Pleased to meet you, Master $$カトル$$.
　I'm delighted to make your acquaintance」

stage0033b_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$カトル$$
「You must be $$ＡＧ$$.
　I've heard about you from $$デュオ$$」

stage0033b_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Such polite speech, even for a slapdash
　robot like myself...
　As expected of you, Master $$カトル$$」

stage0033b_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$カトル$$
「Being addressed like that reminds me
　of everyone in the Maguanac Corps.
　I hope we can build a good relationship too」

stage0033b_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A kind man like you, Master $$カトル$$,
　that's how you talked that $$五飛$$ jerk around」

stage0033b_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Still, that thick-skulled oaf...
　ignoring even Master $$トロワ$$ and Miss $$カレン$$'s pleas,
　what an absolute nutcase」

stage0033b_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$カトル$$
「He's a dear friend of mine.
　Please don't speak of him that way」

stage0033b_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「M, my apologies!
　I... completely forgot that you, Master
　$$カトル$$, have a short fuse!」

stage0033b_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
